newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish DFDS order third roro ship in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Danish DFDS order third roro ship in Italy.

text.p: Danish shipping line DFDS, subsidiary of J.Lauritzen shipping group, said on Monday it took up its option to order a third roll-on roll-off vessel from Italy's Fincantieri Cantieri Navali Italiani shipbuilder.
DFDA said the order followed an original deal with the Ancona-based shipyard in May for two roro vessels with an option on two other ships.
It said the three ships had maximum length of 195 metres, width of 26 metres and 2,800 lane metre capacity.
DFSDS said the ships would sail on its Tor Line unit's routes between Britain, Scandinavia and Belgium, with the first ship due for delivery in April 1998.
No price for the order was disclosed.
